title: Real-time payments for a Tier-1 GCC retail bank

sections.context: A Tier-1 GCC retail bank operating at national scale engaged BGTS to modernise its core banking platform.
sections.challenge: The legacy core could not support real-time payments, and end-of-day batch windows were overrunning into business hours.
sections.approach: BGTS ran a phased shadow migration, processing in parallel on the legacy and new platforms until cutover.
sections.technology: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL.
sections.outcomes: Payment latency reduced 45%. The batch window shortened from 6 hours to 90 minutes. There was zero unplanned downtime during cutover.

citations.claim: batch window shortened from 6 hours to 90 minutes
